attributes.board_name: New Mexico Board of Social Work Examiners

rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-approved CE (board page: approved by NASW, ASWB, NBCC, NM Counseling and Therapy Board, NM Psychology Board); up to 10 self-directed hours per period (programs, readings, audio/video in the social work domain, presenting)
rules.alternatives: A 3-hour college-level course in social work (or skills-related course) is accepted as equivalent to the 30 hours; transcript sent to the board with renewal.
rules.audit_note: Board audits a percentage of renewals; audited licensees submit proof with renewal. Keep CE records for 4 years.
rules.legal_basis: 16.63.12 NMAC (Continuing Education); renewal 16.63.11.11 NMAC, fees 16.63.8 NMAC
rules.notes: Hours must be earned in the current 2-year period July 1–June 30; renewal deadline July 1, late fee $75. Board page says 23 of 30 hours must be board-approved; the NMAC text only caps self-directed hours at 10. Renewal fee varies by level ($100/$150/$200).
